concepts.title: A2A remotes a leaf turn, not the orchestration graph
concepts.rationale: Reuse the existing worker/proxy/AgentHost sequence rather than resurrecting a page-local bridge diagram. Five factory-created workflow agents share the proxy; operator-assistant use is a separate caller. Structured RunEvents travel back through DataContent even though durable persistence stays outside the pod.

concepts.title: Standby, one-time configuration, and turn authentication
concepts.rationale: Refer to the corrected claim/configuration sequence. The prose should distinguish liveness from configured readiness: healthz already returns 200 with standby before configuration. Production launch mints a turn token, but the endpoint code only enforces its equality when it is nonempty; avoid presenting optional configuration fields as unconditional endpoint enforcement.

concepts.title: Shared state, coordinator handoff, and execution transport are distinct channels
concepts.rationale: The diagram correctly separates team-level proposals/context/results from worker-to-pod execution. Keep this overview as the canonical communication map; it does not claim a peer-chat transport.

concepts.title: Prompt layers and the child-run decisions-only exception
concepts.rationale: Keep the prose explanation and channel table; another memory diagram would duplicate the shared owner's concept. Preserve the explicit child exception and avoid implying full memory is compiled into every child. API tools support mid-turn reads and proposals; prompt compilation is an orchestration operation, not a direct pod database read.

concepts.title: Goal to confirmed intent, subtask DAG, and upward results
concepts.rationale: Keep the existing shared-owned embed and its coordinator ownership. No local copy is needed. Child orchestration and results remain distinct from A2A; cross-owner review should retain the confirmation and assemble-ready boundaries.

concepts.title: Worker proxy to AgentHost streaming sequence
concepts.rationale: Retain this bounded transport explanation. The graph stays in the worker and streamed text plus structured events return to the proxy. Configuration and credentials belong in the separate claim/configure explanation.

concepts.title: Three-channel communication recap
concepts.rationale: The recap duplicates the overview and handoff sequence, while its pod-to-shared-brain 'read decisions + memory (compiled into prompt)' arrow mislocates compilation and ignores the child decisions-only exception. Replace the recap embed with a reference to the overview and retain the three explanatory bullets.

concepts.title: Run preparation, agent execution, and durable worktree result
concepts.rationale: Keep the lifecycle identity but add the prepared-writeback branch. The sequence currently shows all results as worker-side commit/diff; remote LocalWritable turns instead deliver a validated prepared-writeback envelope which the worker applies. Label logical components independently of deployment location and keep provider serialization claims distinct from remote session transport.

concepts.title: Native permissions, custom functions, and API authorization
concepts.rationale: The graph currently groups native file/shell/fetch into a path that can reach Allowed, although native shell is unconditionally denied. Separate native-shell denial from conditional custom run_command. Complete the API authorization branch, whose current node has no result/execution edge, and show approval as a possible wait rather than a universal pass-through.

concepts.title: Package seams, per-run tool context, and actual Copilot tool exposure
concepts.rationale: Keep the package and canonical-tool tables plus native-versus-custom prose. The runtime deliberately selects intent/outcome/question/controlled-command tools from the registry rather than exposing all file tools twice. API-hosted approvals are durable; this is useful textual detail rather than another diagram.

concepts.title: Provider-neutral ordered events
concepts.rationale: Keep local event-generation prose and reference the cross-replica durable-stream sequence for persistence and replay. Do not add a second runtime-specific persistence graphic.

concepts.title: RAI verdicts, Scribe, and extension guidance
concepts.rationale: Retain narrow reviewer responsibilities and extension checklist in prose. RAI has explicit machine-readable verdict parsing and configurable fail-closed behavior; Scribe catches failures and exposes a scribe_failed result without throwing the turn failure. Workflow ordering belongs to the orchestration owner.

concepts.title: Separate model-provider, repository, turn, preview, and broker credentials
concepts.rationale: The concise configure-field and security-property tables are preferable to a new token-flow duplicate. Preserve BYOK as the alternative to redeemed UnattendedCopilot capability and separate repository purpose. Qualify 'credentials must not be persisted' by credential type: preview-control credentials have an API-side durable secret-store lifecycle, unlike in-pod memory-only storage.

concepts.title: Credential delivery during warm-pod configuration
concepts.rationale: Use the corrected configure lifecycle as the visual reference. The current document intentionally has no graphic. Distinguish the optional turnBearerToken field from the production executor's always-minted token and from middleware behavior when no token is configured.

concepts.title: Moving heavy execution is independent of the database migration
concepts.rationale: Consolidate the repeated before/after execution story into the pod-evolution canonical. The legacy image couples pod relocation to PostgreSQL, whereas P1 explicitly permits one SQLite writer. Keep P1/P2/P3 distinctions in the adjoining prose, not a second before/after graphic.

concepts.title: Web requests, worker ownership, and per-run compute
concepts.rationale: Keep the valuable logical topology but distinguish scaling rationale from shipped autoscaling. The worker group says it scales on backlog depth; the deployed HPA currently uses CPU/memory Resource metrics and only documents backlog-driven KEDA as an alternative.

concepts.title: CAS acquisition, renewal, fencing, and crash recovery
concepts.rationale: The two-worker acquisition/reclaim sequence matches conditional updates. Retain it, and keep fencing prose precise: renew/release and terminal ownership checks use the token; the illustration does not prove every unrelated write is fenced.

concepts.title: Durable write-through and cross-replica cursor polling
concepts.rationale: Retain this specific production sequence: it correctly shows persistence before acknowledgement and different web replicas polling shared rows. Correct accompanying prose that still says serializable transaction; current PostgreSQL appends use ReadCommitted plus a per-run advisory transaction lock. Do not replace this with a process-local fan-out diagram.

concepts.title: Ordered durable events and cursor resumption
concepts.rationale: The current short page has no embedded visual. Reference the existing cross-replica sequence rather than reintroducing the shared-owned events-observability-fig3. Preserve PostgreSQL versus local SQLite distinction.

concepts.title: Operational events versus Azure Monitor telemetry
concepts.rationale: Keep the brief separation between per-run facts and telemetry-backed metrics/traces. It names real endpoints and does not need an architecture graphic that duplicates the token-monitoring explanation.

concepts.title: AKS workload, storage, and identity overview
concepts.rationale: Consolidate with the guide-owned AKS component canonical after cross-owner correction. This legacy graph omits the worker, retains the removed generic sandbox pool, draws direct Key Vault-to-AgentHost, and mounts CSI secrets into MCP. The target also needs its Worker x1 annotation corrected against the x2 deployment; do not treat target reuse as approval of its current content.

concepts.title: TLS termination and path-based backend selection
concepts.rationale: Keep the routing sequence, distinct from the component map. Specific API/OAuth and MCP routes precede frontend fallback; worker orchestration is not a public backend.

concepts.title: Workload identity and CSI-delivered API/worker secrets
concepts.rationale: Change the receiving process from API/MCP to API/worker and separate identity authorization from secret data flow. MCP does not mount secrets. AgentHost receives purpose-bound configure data and must not be drawn as a vault consumer.

concepts.title: Build or retag images, apply prerequisites, roll out workloads
concepts.rationale: The graph's build-versus-retag split is now implemented and should be retained. Correct the prose, which falsely calls retagging unimplemented and names a five-image shell script. The current Node image catalog has four images, and deployment includes the worker and HPA.

concepts.title: PostgreSQL durability and RWX workspaces
concepts.rationale: Keep the storage explanation without a duplicate diagram. Reconcile contradictory rebuild/failure advice: the page correctly describes PostgreSQL and RollingUpdate but later recommends memory.db/PVC backup and Recreate/RWO handling as though they were current production.

concepts.title: Separate sandbox control ingress, preview ingress, and public HTTPS egress
concepts.rationale: Retain the concept in prose but correct the assertions of no sandbox inbound traffic and domain-enforced Kata egress. Current policy permits preview-gateway TCP 3000-9000 and public-IP HTTPS with private/link-local exclusions; the manifest explicitly explains why Kata traffic cannot rely on Cilium DNS interception. Distinguish checked-in policy from historical live measurements.

concepts.title: Build/Test verdict, preview preparation, approval, and publication outcome
concepts.rationale: Keep the sequence identity but correct terminal branches: DECLINED terminates assembly rather than continuing human review; unresolved command is preview_failed, not infrastructure-not-applicable; approval can expire or be denied; route creation alone is not preview_ready. Include actual HTTPS publication validation and rollback. Command resolution also has a model fallback, so deterministic ownership should not be described as entirely model-free command discovery.

concepts.title: Gateway route, supervised process, and retained claim lifetimes
concepts.rationale: Keep the existing explanation as the canonical textual lifecycle. Durable route state derives Previewable/PreviewActive; keepalive touches the process and claim retention, while the final route controls return to normal cleanup. This is substantial but already compactly explained and need not gain a second preview lifecycle graphic.

concepts.title: Per-run control credentials and child-process isolation
concepts.rationale: Keep credential separation, cleanup, and scrubbing in prose. Clarify API publication probing versus prohibited direct pod-port probing: the opening 'never probes' statement is only true of the latter.

concepts.title: Gateway data plane and API publication control plane
concepts.rationale: Retain Gateway/Service/forwarder/app relationships, but the API sublabel 'creates objects only' is stale. It now probes the exact generated HTTPS URL before reporting readiness. Clearly separate this control-plane validation from the prohibited API-to-pod preview-port probe.

concepts.title: Agent preview request, authorization, approval, and failure outcomes
concepts.rationale: The current sequence proceeds to StartPreviewAsync after either Approved or DeniedOrTimedOut. Add explicit denial/timeout returns and only publish on approval. Update prose provenance: start_preview moved out of AgentweaverApiTools into PreviewRunnerToolProvider/PreviewPublishTool, and endpoint authorization uses contributor run access with an internal-service allowance, not the old owner-only helper.

concepts.title: Capability URLs, cluster-state lookup, TTL, reaping, and MCP reuse
concepts.rationale: Keep the detailed prose rather than splitting it into several near-duplicate diagrams. Cluster-state claim lookup and HTTPRoute annotations avoid replica affinity; token/run checks and cleanup have direct regression coverage. Preserve distinction between Gateway capability-token session_id and PreviewRunner session id, and between public URL and local kubectl fallback.

concepts.title: Shared worker execution becomes per-run AgentHost compute
concepts.rationale: Retain the compute-only migration canonical and reuse it from scaling. It does not force a simultaneous PostgreSQL transition. Correct the page's before-only alt text, which does not describe the existing migration/claim/configure graph.

concepts.title: Host backend selection versus in-pod command isolation
concepts.rationale: Reuse the fuller router/factory ladder from sandbox.md. This duplicate attributes Kubernetes selection to the local factory, labels wsl-unshare real isolation, and only connects K8s/direct to sandbox.selected. Keep the in-pod PodExec/Kata seam separate from this host selection ladder.

concepts.title: Kata VM, AgentHost, executor sidecar, and per-command mount namespace
concepts.rationale: A genuinely missing boundary diagram would explain a large, difficult prose section: separate AgentHost/executor PID namespaces, shared pod network, pod-private authenticated IPC on memory emptyDir, run-only mount view, registered HOME, read-only git metadata, and absent shared PVC root in model processes. Keep historical incident transcripts as prose; do not imply a nested bwrap PID namespace or claim PNG publication.

concepts.title: Claim adoption, standby health, configuration, and endpoint registration
concepts.rationale: Correct sequence order: the executor waits for healthz reachability before POST /configure; healthz returns standby with 200. Successful configuration prepares the actual shared/local execution workspace before endpoint registration. Include Copilot-or-BYOK provider data and separate registries instead of putting token and endpoint operations on a generic PodNameRegistry. Claims do not inject spec.env in the shipped warm-pool path.

concepts.title: Verified ephemeral checkout and authoritative write-back
concepts.rationale: Retain materialize/verify/read-only/writable/nested-repo concepts but split the final push from authoritative application. AgentHost pushes a temporary ref; the worker validates descriptor, immutable parent/tree and branch state before fast-forward. Add the no-change path and runtime HOME outside the checkout; do not suggest the push directly mutates the active worktree.

concepts.title: Active burst, suspension, release, resume, and preview retention
concepts.rationale: The inline state machine is an uncovered visual, not a catalog PNG. Preserve the state-model concept but distinguish normal release from preview-retained claims and label re-claim as adoption of a replacement pod, not returning a used configured pod to standby. Code supports release-on-suspend; the stronger promise of perfect remote provider-session rehydration is not established by this audit and needs separate evidence before being drawn as guaranteed.

concepts.title: Returning operator approval to the owning AgentHost gate
concepts.rationale: Retain the distinct missing-return-leg explanation: resolve owning child, try durable gate, then authenticated pod fallback for unknown requests. Keep detailed nonterminal HTTP mappings in the table/prose rather than overloading the successful sequence.

concepts.title: Kubernetes-owned admission and provisioning stall exemption
concepts.rationale: Keep the heartbeat story but stop conflating a Ready claim with configured AgentHost readiness. The poll waits for controller binding and emits child-stream heartbeats; pod IP, standby health and configure still follow. Distinguish coordinator scheduling the child from the child already provisioning its leaf pod.

concepts.title: Package installation, disposable system root, and optional per-run BuildKit
concepts.rationale: Retain the capability table and concrete limitations. Distinguish Linux-incompatible winget, unavailable builder, and supported package tools. The optional BuildKit sidecar has elevated capabilities, no workspace mount, and CNI-isolated build-step networking; do not label the optional deployment as the baseline pod. Historical measurement tables are evidence claims from their original experiments, not new live verification by this worker.

concepts.title: System, application, and Kata node pools
concepts.rationale: The table and example commands communicate pool roles more precisely than another AKS diagram. Keep scheduling preference versus toleration explicit, and avoid 'never stranded' as an availability guarantee: preferred affinity does not create capacity.

concepts.title: Credential and browser-preview cross-references
concepts.rationale: Reuse the concise credential table and link to the existing preview data-path diagram rather than creating local duplicates. Correct the rebuild instruction to fetch a user token from Key Vault inside the pod with no broker: it directly contradicts the purpose-bound /configure contract on the same page.

concepts.title: Governance, filesystem, execution, and network boundaries
concepts.rationale: Keep the shared-owned boundary embed; coordinate factual labels with its owner rather than edit it here. Per-file open-handle verification and governed custom shell remain distinct controls, not substitutes for pod/process isolation.

concepts.title: Explicit override, cluster selection, and local fallback ladder
concepts.rationale: Retain this fuller selection graph and reuse it from the pod page. It correctly places explicit local/kubernetes override before in-cluster detection and shows Kubernetes initialization failing closed. Local direct fallback is real behavior, not proof of an explicit user opt-in.

concepts.title: Utility command claims versus AgentHost turn claims
concepts.rationale: Keep the utility-command lifecycle distinct from the AgentHost sequence, but label its scope explicitly and correct preview lookup. PodNameRegistry is not the authority for replica-safe Gateway preview. The generic sleep-infinity sandbox template/image is removed; explain that this retained command API is not a separately deployed production warm pool.

concepts.title: Lexical validation, real-path verification, bounded search and output
concepts.rationale: Retain detailed path and TOCTOU explanation as prose underneath the shared boundary graphic. These are precise invariants and limitations, not an additional system topology.

concepts.title: Current configure fields, real pod hardening, and ingress exceptions
concepts.rationale: Reuse the corrected claim/configure sequence and retain hardening limits in prose. Update stale claims about spec.env injection, shared-only SetupAsync paths, no inbound traffic, and blanket no-token/read-only-root hardening. The real template has automountServiceAccountToken true on the AgentHost pod and readOnlyRootFilesystem false, while the executor sidecar deliberately lacks identity.

concepts.title: Local command isolation as defense in depth
concepts.rationale: Keep the shared boundary embed; update its stale alt text rather than author a second MXC overview. Correct the absolute 'no unsandboxed command by default' claim: the local factory can automatically return direct, and registration admits direct when ShellEnabled is true.

concepts.title: Backend table, timeout envelope, and actual tool registration
concepts.rationale: Retain backend and policy tables, but distinguish canonical registry contents from the smaller live Copilot custom-tool set. Avoid saying the full ten-file-tool catalog is registered for the live runner. Direct skips governance's isolation/shell checks but does not bypass the registry's ShellEnabled prerequisite.

concepts.title: Shell approval persistence and narrowly scoped repository capabilities
concepts.rationale: Keep repository-credential constraints as prose, but replace the API-hosted in-memory-only approval claim. The API overrides runtime defaults with DurableShellApprovalStore and DurableToolApprovalGate; a local runtime default is not the production cross-replica contract.

concepts.title: MXC/WSL/Linux setup and platform limitations
concepts.rationale: Retain installation commands, probe JSON, policy-version explanation and limitations as runbook content. They do not need graphics. Preserve the wsl-unshare non-real-isolation distinction and Windows network warning. Historical binary-bundling status should be separately rechecked before publication rather than inferred from the legacy diagram.

concepts.title: Durable usage events and Azure Monitor metrics/traces
concepts.rationale: Keep the current concise flow. It correctly excludes the retired projection store and usage routes. Do not reinsert shared-owned token-usage-monitoring-fig1 without its owner's current-code audit. The runtime emits AgentTurnUsage separately from a nano-AIU metric.

concepts.title: Metrics endpoints and AI-credit conversion
concepts.rationale: Retain endpoint table and the text formula; neither benefits from a diagram. Preserve the difference between telemetry availability and stored-data fallback, rather than promising identical completeness for both.

findings.subject: Configuration readiness is reversed in the legacy pod sequence
findings.detail: The executor probes healthz before configure, and healthz returns 200 standby before SetupAsync. Several pages and fig6 still promise 200 only after configure. Claim Ready, reachable standby, and configured turn readiness must be distinct. Correct fig5 as well so Kubernetes binding is not presented as finished AgentHost configuration.

findings.subject: Preview graphics omit publication and incorrectly fall through failed approvals
findings.detail: Gateway resource creation is not readiness: exact HTTPS publication must succeed. Agent preview denial/timeout returns 403/408 instead of reaching StartPreviewAsync. The deterministic preview sequence also conflates command-unresolved failure with infrastructure skip and depicts DECLINED as continuing review.

findings.subject: Infrastructure prose and visuals mix several retired deployment generations
findings.detail: The graph retains a generic warm pool, direct AgentHost vault access and MCP CSI mount; prose omits worker as a distinct workload, claims five images/no retag, and revives SQLite backup/Recreate/RWO advice. Current code has four image specs, implemented retag, a worker deployment, PostgreSQL and RollingUpdate. Merge the component graph into corrected guide-owned canonical-aks-components; that target's Worker x1 label also needs owner correction.

findings.subject: Sandbox boundary claims exceed checked-in implementation
findings.detail: Reconcile no-ingress/FQDN-only/read-only-root/no-token blanket statements with actual control/preview exceptions, public-IP HTTPS policy, AgentHost writable root and its service-account token. The executor sidecar's separate identity/PID/mount boundary is essential. Historical measured cluster claims are not evidence of current effective policy and were not re-executed here.

findings.subject: Obsolete credentials and tool-source claims persist beside corrected prose
findings.detail: The pod rebuild checklist still instructs direct Key Vault user-token fetching without a broker. Agent preview prose still attributes start_preview to AgentweaverApiTools and old owner-only authorization. The actual provider is PreviewRunnerToolProvider/PreviewPublishTool and current endpoint checks contributor access with internal-service allowance. Do not reuse those stale source labels in new drawings.

findings.subject: Local shell policy prose contradicts factory and registration behavior
findings.detail: Direct fallback can be automatic when no local isolation backend is available; it is not always an explicit operator opt-out. The registry still requires ShellEnabled, even though governance exempts direct internally. wsl-unshare reports non-real isolation. API-hosted approvals are durable, not only InMemoryShellApprovalStore.

findings.subject: Scaling mechanisms and desired scaling rationale are conflated
findings.detail: The worker HPA uses resource metrics rather than backlog depth; PostgreSQL event allocation uses advisory locking under ReadCommitted rather than serializable transactions. The cross-replica polling diagram itself remains accurate and should not be replaced by a local-channel-only canonical sequence.

findings.subject: Inline pod lifecycle and remote session guarantees need bounded wording
findings.detail: The page has an inline Mermaid state model outside the PNG catalog. Release-on-suspend exists, but retained previews can prevent release and immutable local workspaces can require claim recreation. Perfect serialized remote-provider-session rehydration was not proven by the inspected proxy, which creates an A2A session by run ID; do not turn the page's broad guarantee into a certified diagram fact.

findings.subject: Two assigned-page links resolve to missing local files
findings.detail: agent-communication.md links to the removed specs/018-distributed-agent-execution-scaling/spec.md; replace with the current distributed-execution-scaling.md explanation or a coordinator-approved current spec. distributed-execution-scaling.md links to ../architecture-aks.md, but the assigned guide path is ../guide/architecture-aks.md. Fix these consumer links during the later prose pass; no source diagram is needed.

findings.subject: Four bounded consolidations and one genuinely missing graphic
findings.detail: Merge communication recap -> canonical-agent-communication-shared; execution-before/after -> canonical-sandbox-pod-evolution; infrastructure overview -> corrected guide-owned canonical-aks-components; duplicate backend ladder -> sandbox-fig2. Propose one new AgentHost/executor/Kata/mount-boundary diagram with canonical_diagram null. Keep capability, credential, metrics and node-pool detail textual rather than generating redundant diagrams.

findings.subject: Research-only provenance and publication boundary
findings.detail: All 13 assigned pages and all 24 owned legacy JSON sources were read, including their structural labels/edges and the inline Mermaid state model. No assigned page contains an embedded screenshot, SVG or iframe. PNGs were not visually inspected. All owned sources remain legacy JSON with edit-JSON provenance, whereas current authoring policy requires canonical uncompressed draw.io; retain dispositions preserve semantic identity only and do not certify pitch/iterate completion. No diagrams, prose, code, git state, or foreign reports were edited.
